states.name: Michigan
states.about: Michigan's Charitable Gaming Division lists licensed weekly bingo games with the day and hours.
states.hours_note: Hours come from Michigan's weekly bingo license list. Call ahead to ask when the first game starts.
states.list_label: Michigan Charitable Gaming Division: Find a Weekly Bingo
states.regulator_note: Michigan bingo is licensed by the Michigan Lottery's Charitable Gaming Division, 517-335-5780.

states.name: Indiana
states.about: The Indiana Gaming Commission lists groups with a current license that allows bingo. Its list does not show game days or times.
states.license_note: Indiana's license list shows this group can hold bingo, but not when. Call or look them up before you go.
states.list_label: Indiana Gaming Commission: Qualified Organizations with Current Licenses
states.regulator_note: Indiana bingo is licensed by the Indiana Gaming Commission's Charity Gaming Division, 317-232-4646.

states.name: Ohio
states.about: Ohio has its own free bingo finder with game days and times, from the same team.
states.list_label: Ohio Attorney General: authorized bingo locations
states.regulator_note: Ohio bingo is licensed by the Ohio Attorney General.

states.name: Kentucky
states.about: We haven't found a public list of Kentucky bingo games yet, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_note: Kentucky bingo is licensed by the Office of Charitable Gaming, now part of Kentucky Horse Racing & Gaming.

states.name: West Virginia
states.about: We haven't found a public list of West Virginia bingo games yet, so we're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: West Virginia Tax Division: bingo and raffle licenses
states.regulator_note: West Virginia bingo is licensed by the State Tax Commissioner, 304-558-3333.

states.name: Pennsylvania
states.about: Pennsylvania bingo licenses come from each county, and we haven't found a statewide list of games yet. We're building one with help from halls and players.
states.regulator_label: How county bingo licenses work (Cumberland County example)
states.regulator_note: In Pennsylvania, bingo licenses are issued by each county treasurer's office.

states.name: Florida
states.about: Florida does not license bingo statewide, so there is no state list of games. We're building one from places that publish their own schedules, with help from halls and players.
states.hours_note: Game days come from each place's own published schedule. Call ahead to confirm.
states.regulator_note: Under Florida law, charities, veterans' groups and some homeowners' and mobile home park associations may run bingo; some counties, such as Pinellas, also license it locally.
